title: Great sightseeing & treasure hunting
text:
Excellent way to see Barcelona - interesting and casual and with some very good guides. 

We got both history of Picasso and saw a lot of the old town. 

Can very much recommend!
author: ldane

title: Bachelorette Hunt
text: With the 6 of us we celebrated a Bachelorette, we thought that it was a unique idea to do a Treasure Hunt. We did not want to go drinking and feel hangover afterwards, but something meaningful that leaves a lasting impact on the memory we are creating. The way it was set up was just that. A fun impactful with lots of fun memories because we connected as a group. The game master was so much fun , she knew how to redirect a negative one into an actionable one, very understanding and easy to connect with. Definitely to recommend from our side
author: JayGitanoM

title: The Spy: best outdoors game!!
text: What an amazing experience, this is by far the best outdoors treasure hunt I’ve played. We did The Spy one and it is like an immersive experience, not only following clues. You can definitively tell there’s a lot of details that has been considered to create this experience. Absolutely recommend it 💜💯
author: marum716

title: Hen party treasure hunt
text: Hugs was the best guide, so lovely and friendly!! We had so much fun and will recommend to anyone heading to Barcelona!!  Was the best way to see the city, thank you Hugo for your time and Thank you so much for the great memories
